It stands for "House in Multiple Occupation" and refers to properties where three or more unrelated people live, usually with separate bedrooms but shared facilities such as kitchens and bathrooms While HMOs are often associated with students and young professionals, they can also provide accommodation for people leaving prison, those recovering from drug or alcohol problems, and refugees Police in Salford have said they believe that the recent spate of vandalism aimed at HMOs in the area has been "racially or religiously motivated" The term HMO was formalised in the Housing Act 1985. The organisation provides Saturday lessons in Czech language, history and geography for children who attend other schools during the week. Image caption, St Teresa's RC Primary School in Firswood, Trafford, is due to close on 31 August 2027 after a decline in pupil numbers Mataskova said the school was one of 15 Czech education providers worldwide with an agreement with the Czech Ministry of Education. This update explains the current position, what survey activity means and how local people can take part in any future planning process In August 2026, Wigan Council’s Cabinet agreed to object to Peel Land’s proposed Gibfield Park masterplan. Cabinet’s position was that the housing and industrial proposals were not acceptable in their current form and did not have cabinet members’ support. No planning application West of Gibfield was allocated for homes, employment and green space through Places for Everyone, which was adopted in 2024 and now forms part of the statutory development plan. The current Wigan Local Plan process cannot reverse that allocation. However, allocation does not gran Our chief executive has written to the Greater Manchester Combined Authority, requesting Gibfield to be removed from the plan. We are waiting for a response Cabinet has formally objected to the proposed masterplan and made clear that it cannot support the development now or in the future Peel Land may undertake ecology surveys, ground-condition testing, environmental work and traffic or transport studies to understand the site and prepare evidence. These investigations do not mean planning permission has been granted or that a future application will be approved

input.evidence_text: Mr Thomas’s Chop House has been part of Manchester since 1867. A £300,000 restoration, long-term lease and 23-year-old head chef are shaping what comes next Go to Manchester's Finest X profile Mr Thomas’s Chop House has been serving Manchester since 1867, but owner Roger Ward admits there was a point after Covid when he wasn’t sure how much longer he wanted to keep doing it Tom’s had gone eight years without a proper lease and much longer without any meaningful investment by the landlord. Retirement was being seriously considered. Instead, Roger decided to “go again properly” That decision has resulted in a new long-term commitment to the Chop Houses and around £300,000 being spent restoring Tom’s – touching everything from the dining rooms and furniture to the menu, wine list, kitchen and beer cellars Roger is particularly pleased with the toilets “Tom’s was famous for the shittest toilets in town,” he says. input.evidence_text: Bolton Car Boot Sale is one of the North West's biggest weekly boot sales, held in the hardstanding car park of the Macron Stadium (formerly Reebok), Burnden Way, Horwich, Bolton BL6 6JW. Sellers can arrive and set up from 6:00 AM, with buyers welcomed in from 7:00 AM. Entry costs just £1 per car for buyers. Pitches for sellers are £14 for a car, £20 for a van and £3 for a trailer, with regular and corner pitches available on request. Bring exact change to keep the queue moving, and call organiser Andrew on 07470784644 for more details. Expect hundreds of stalls across the concrete hardstanding pitches, so it goes ahead in most weather. On-site you'll find a 5-star catering service, doughnuts and coffee, ice cream and desserts, a meat auction, fresh fruit and veg, plants, and retro sweet stalls. The sale is dog-friendly, has male and female toilets, ample parking, and kids' rides and bouncy castles to keep little ones entertained.
